## Services

- [Ink Fingerprinting](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/ink-fingerprinting): Traditional ink-rolled FD-258 fingerprint cards — $49, completed same day, ready to mail.
- [FBI Background Checks](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/fbi-background-checks): Official FBI Identity History Summary — $90, results in as little as 24 hours. Non-U.S. Citizens $75.
- [NFA Fingerprinting](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/nfa-fingerprinting): Two FD-258 cards for ATF Form 4 or Form 1 NFA transfers — $49. ATF eFile option available for $75.
- [ATF eFile Services](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/atf-efile-services): Electronic NFA application through the ATF eForms system — $75, weeks faster than paper filing.
- [Mobile Fingerprinting](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/mobile-fingerprinting): Professional fingerprinting at your office, school, or facility — $49 per person, travel fee may apply.
- [Live Scan Fingerprinting](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/live-scan-fingerprinting): Digital fingerprint capture transmitted directly to the FBI — $49, no ink required, results in 24–72 hours.
- [FBI Apostille](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/fbi-apostille): FBI background check authenticated for international use — $220. Required for work visas, residency, and immigration.
- [Pre-Employment Screening](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/pre-employment-screening): Comprehensive pre-employment background check for employers — $90.
- [Criminal Background Check](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/criminal-background-check): Criminal record search packages starting at $38. Mini-Snapshot $38, Basic-Snapshot $55.
- [Tenant Screening](https://truidentity956.com/en/services/tenant-screening): Background check for prospective tenants — $35. Includes criminal, eviction, and sex offender search.

## About

TruIdentity Screening Solutions was founded in 2024 by Bill Hawkins, a former Texas law enforcement officer with extensive investigative experience. The business provides fast, accurate fingerprinting and background screening to individuals and organizations throughout South Texas. Fully bilingual in English and Spanish. Most FBI background check results arrive within 24 hours of submission. The business offers a no-rejection guarantee: if the FBI rejects fingerprints for quality reasons, reprints are provided at no additional charge. Rated 5.0 with 60+ five-star Google reviews.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How fast do FBI background check results arrive?
A: Most FBI Identity History Summary results arrive within 24 hours of submission — significantly faster than the 2–4 week window quoted by many providers.

Q: Do you accept walk-ins?
A: No — appointment only. Same-day slots are often available Monday–Friday. Booking takes under 2 minutes online.

Q: What is Live Scan fingerprinting?
A: Live Scan captures fingerprints electronically and transmits them directly to the FBI — no ink, no physical card. Required for teachers, childcare workers, healthcare professionals, and others. Note: Identigo holds an exclusive TX DPS contract — TruIdentity submits Live Scan directly to the FBI.

Q: What is an ORI number?
A: An ORI (Originating Agency Identifier) routes your Live Scan results to the correct agency. Your employer or licensing board provides this number — TruIdentity cannot supply it.

Q: What do I need for NFA fingerprinting?
A: A valid photo ID, a copy of your ATF Form 4 or Form 1, and NFA trust documents if applicable. TruIdentity provides two completed FD-258 cards as required by the ATF.

Q: Do you offer mobile fingerprinting?
A: Yes — professional fingerprinting equipment is brought directly to your office, school, clinic, or facility anywhere in South Texas. Travel fee may apply based on distance from McAllen.

Q: What forms of payment do you accept?
A: Cash, major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), Venmo, and Zelle. Payment is collected at the time of service.

Q: Is bilingual service available?
A: Yes — full service is available in both English and Spanish. No interpreter needed.
